entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: A planeswalker and werewolf who defends the Harvesttide festival and fights her old mentor Tovolar, finally changing under the night sky.

entities.name: Tovolar
entities.description: A huge werewolf and Arlinn's former mentor who leads the lycanthrope raid on Harvesttide and urges Arlinn to join the hunt.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: A vain, murderous vampire lady who wears a flayed maiden's face and decides to let the humans' ritual proceed.

entities.name: Feuer
entities.description: Olivia's servant, a purveyor of ossuary furniture who spied on the humans in Gavony and reports Harvesttide.

entities.name: Deidamia
entities.description: A witch of the coven who carves pumpkin suns for children at the festival and feels a ward fall.

entities.name: Shana
entities.description: Deidamia's witch friend who first spots the heroes arriving.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker whom Arlinn sends away with the Moonsilver Key to take it to Katilda.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who slows time with his staff to hold off the sunset and protect the festival.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer who rides out with Adeline to the front line and fights with fire from her gauntlets.

entities.name: Adeline
entities.description: A natural leader who commands the cathars defending the festival in shield walls.

entities.name: Katilda
entities.description: The leader of the Dawnheart Coven, who is waiting for the key.

entities.name: Streak
entities.description: One of Arlinn's wolves, now with the attackers.

entities.name: Patience
entities.description: Arlinn's wolf who begs her to join the hunt.

entities.name: Redtooth
entities.description: One of Arlinn's wolves, now with the attackers.

entities.name: Boulder
entities.description: Arlinn's wolf, who bowls her over at Tovolar's command.

entities.name: Dires
entities.description: Huge lycanthropes taller than blacksmiths, who fight with hammers in the raid.

entities.name: Howlpack
entities.description: Tovolar's pack of werewolves, shamans, bruisers and armored wolves attacking the festival.

entities.name: Dawnheart Coven
entities.description: The witches running the Harvesttide ritual and warding the festival.

entities.name: Cathars
entities.description: The armored guards who form shield walls to protect the festivalgoers.

entities.name: Moonsilver Key
entities.description: The key that Teferi hands to Kaya to take to Katilda for the ritual.

entities.name: The Celestus
entities.description: The ancient structure at the center of the festival where the people shelter.

entities.name: Harvesttide
entities.description: The festival meant to restore the balance of day and night, attacked by Tovolar's wolves at sunset.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane whose last sunset is dying.

entities.name: Kessig
entities.description: The region where the festival and Celestus stand.

entities.name: Gavony
entities.description: A region where Feuer saw vampire effigies being prepared for Harvesttide.

events.summary: Feuer wakes Olivia Voldaren to report that the humans are holding a festival to restore the balance of day and night.
events.quote: They're up to something. Trying to restore the balance of day and night, I believe.

events.summary: Feuer reports that he burned a vampire effigy, saw Arlinn Kord leading the search, and learned that the humans seem to have the Moonsilver Key.
events.quote: I recognized their leader. Arlinn Kord

events.summary: Olivia decides to let the festival proceed, saying never to interrupt someone doing your work for you.
events.quote: Never interrupt someone when they're doing your work for you.

events.summary: At the festival under the Celestus, witch Deidamia carves pumpkin suns for children while the witches wait for the key.
events.quote: A sun and moon engrave themselves on the spot the girl picks

events.summary: The heroes arrive to cheers, but a ward falls and howling begins.
events.quote: Deidamia feels the too-sharp pain of a ward going down.

events.summary: Howlpack shamans and hundreds of wolves attack the barriers while the witches usher the festivalgoers toward the center of the Celestus.
events.quote: doesn't see them beating against the barriers until the shaman-wolves are already upon them

events.summary: Arlinn sends Kaya off with the Moonsilver Key to deliver it to Katilda, and Chandra and Adeline ride to the front.
events.quote: "Kaya, take the key. Make sure it gets to Katilda."

events.summary: The magical barrier shatters and the wall of werewolves crashes into the festivalgoers.
events.quote: Overhead, the magic shatters like stained glass

events.summary: Teferi plants his staff and slows time to hold back the sunset, calling on the witches to start the ritual.
events.quote: "Witches of the Dawnheart Coven!" he bellows, "Let's get this ritual started!"

events.summary: Adeline commands the cathars in shield walls while Teferi's time magic stutters a dire's hammer.
events.quote: Clusters of cathars stand back to back with spears and shields

events.summary: Arlinn smashes a dire's knee with a mace and the cathars finish him, and the dire names her Tovolar's favorite.
Arlinn remembers that after two years under Tovolar's tutelage she left him scarred and bleeding and ran away in the night.
events.quote: she left him scarred and bleeding then ran away in the middle of the night

events.summary: Arlinn confronts Tovolar and demands he call off the raid; he refuses.
Arlinn attacks Tovolar with a mace, which he catches and tears from her hands.
events.quote: Tovolar catches the head of the mace.

events.summary: Arlinn punches Tovolar and offers to let him take the nights back if he spares the humans, but he rejects it.
events.quote: Take the nights back, hunt what you can, but leave the humans out of this.

events.summary: Tovolar transforms and presses her; Arlinn takes a sword from a fallen guard and Tovolar claws her cheek.
events.quote: his claws tear open her cheek.

events.summary: Arlinn recalls the night she challenged Tovolar for the alpha position and the scar she gave him.
events.quote: And then she'd be the alpha of the howlpack.

events.summary: Her wolves close in and Patience begs Arlinn to join the hunt; Arlinn says she cannot, and Boulder bowls her over.
events.quote: True to his name, when he throws his weight against her, she's bowled over

events.summary: Tovolar pins Arlinn and demands she show him the real Arlinn; the sun sets and Arlinn changes into a wolf.
events.quote: The sun sinks below the horizon. Day changes to night.

relations.note: She spent two years under his tutelage.
relations.quote: after two years under his tutelage

relations.note: She fights him to stop the raid.
He reports to her as a servant.
relations.quote: "My most illustrious and powerful Lady Olivia Voldaren."
their friend Shana holds up a mug of spiced cider

relations.note: Deidamia follows Katilda's instruction to wait for the key.
relations.quote: Katilda was clear: wait for the key.

relations.note: Arlinn's wolves have joined his pack.

relations.quote: "I was going to tell you I owed you a long sunset."

relations.note: The guards heed her orders naturally.
relations.quote: the gathered guards heed her orders as naturally as breathing

relations.note: The Kessig earth is soaked at the festival.
relations.quote: Is it blood or wine that soaks the Kessig earth?
